ranking.name: Crowne Plaza New Orleans French Quarter

text.text_excerpt: This hotel, although a bit pricier then other options in the local area, was a very nice stay for me and my gaggle of friends, in town for fun... no work. :-P The hotel was very nice, clean well kept lobby and rooms, and a very nice restaurant on the first floor (though we never visited it). Our room was 2 double beds, on the Bourbon street side and above the pool. We were high enough to avoid most of the noise of Bourbon St, and were very capable of sleeping off our nightly drinking binges. Although, in our defense, we got our immaturity out BEFORE coming to the hotel. I had the opportunity to stay in this hotel when I was in New Orleans for the first time on an assignment for work. There was a national dance competition being held at the hotel and I was part of the video crew that filmed and broadcast it live. When I was first told I'd be staying at the hotel, I looked up the OTHER Yelp REVIEWS and had mixed feelings aout what I read. Pro's: I'm staying on Bourbon Street? Cool! N/A Internet is $10? That's about what everybody charges these days $10-$13 per day. Besides, I have my own mifi hotspot. Parking is expensive? I didn't bring a car, not my problem Cons It's going to be really loud? The rooms smell musty? No full length mirror in the room? Poor ...

I just got home yesterday after a three night stay at this hotel. Let me start by saying that we booked this particular hotel because it's at the corner of Canal & Bourbon Streets... proximity and easy walking to everything in the French Quarter and beyond (if you enjoy walking, that is)... This hotel was updated and refurbished several years ago... the lobby really is beautiful, and the bar downstairs is great for coffee or a quick drink on the go before sightseeing... The rooms are sufficient. The beds, I must admit, are VERY comfortable, but the tubs and showers REALLY could use a face-lift and some updating. The water pressure was not great, and our shower dripped pretty much constant...
